Jumped Fair sat 4l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, ran on well no match winner # had chance
Slow away. Not pushed early & raced 4th 3 Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Held Ground until pushed along 8W (4L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground 8W in straight. # Average effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced wide withotu cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace & 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed out Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased steadily without threatening in last 200m. # Had her chance.

Away soundly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & tracking leaders on rail (2L from lead) on home turn. Back to inside @ cutaway & challenged leaders @ 200m. Pressured @ 150m & drew clear in last 100m. # Well ridden
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear 3 Wide With Cover midrace & pushed out Five Wide @ 350m. Pushed along & carried out 8W (5L from lead) on home turn. Ran on fairly Seven Wide in last 200m. # Wide/OK late
